messages:
maria nguyen: Kicking off migration window for release v2.14. Deploybot will run MIG_2026_03_21_1. Canary on shard-01, bulk on shard-02 after verification.

deploybot: [DEPLOYBOT] Starting MIG_2026_03_21_1 on shard-02 (job=48291)

samir patel: watching pg locks on shard-02. lock wait climbing, currently median=1.1s, some spikes ~2s. tailing pg_stat_activity.

jonathan lee: if median lock wait >2s for 2m we should auto-pause. what's our exact rollback cutoff?

priya rao: Suggest circuit-breaker: condition = median_lock_wait >2s AND error_rate_delta >0.5% sustained 180s -> pause migration. If not recoverable in 10m -> rollback to v2.13.
maria nguyen: agree. also reduce backfill concurrency to 25% when breaker flips before full pause.

priya rao: mitigation snippets for control plane:
```bash
# throttle backfill on a shard
backfillctl set-rate --shard=02 --rate=50r/s
# set diagnostic mode to reduce writes
curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN\" https://console.internal/flags -d '{"migration_diag": true}'
```

deploybot: [DEPLOYBOT] Circuit-breaker evaluation: median_lock_wait=2.3s, error_rate=1.1% -> triggering soft-throttle on shard-02 (rate->50r/s).

samir patel: saw a stray long tx (worker 87) holding an exclusive lock; going to terminate if it doesn't finish in 30s.

maria nguyen: apply soft-throttle and start draining inflight workers on shard-02. Canary on shard-01 still green.

samir patel: terminated backend pid 91234 (worker 87). locks released. running quick health query:
```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM user_profiles WHERE migrated_v2 = false AND updated_at < now() - interval '7 days';
```

jonathan lee: plan: if shard-01 healthy for 10m -> resume shard-02 at 50% batch and tighter lock timeout. If not -> execute rollback runbook.

priya rao: rollback short checklist: stop new migration jobs; run down SQL; restore pinned schema v2.13 routing; unset migration flags; monitor 30m. runbook link: https://runbook.internal/migrations/rollback-short

maria nguyen: pausing shard-02 now (set-rate=0) until canary window completes. updating release notes with known issue. :thumbsup:

deploybot: [DEPLOYBOT] backfillctl set-rate --shard=02 --rate=0 executed (job=48292). Migration paused on shard-02. Next auto-check in 5m (1745306801).
